summary: Today’s tape is risk-on in crude and cautious in crypto, with bitcoin, ether, and solana all slightly negative while oil and gold remain elevated amid inflation and rate-hike concerns. The strongest fresh themes are a potential crypto-regulation catalyst around the Clarity Act, persistent strength in Brent and gold, and continued attention on AI megacaps and FX carry-risk.
